claims.text: The August 2025 AARO data-standardisation workshop produced a white paper published in February 2026 recommending standardised metadata templates, AI with human oversight, and open narrative reporting.
AARO held a private workshop on UAP data standardisation with civilian researchers and academia on 1 August 2025.
A UAP Science Advisory Council formation was announced on 17 June 2026.
